control: 'Deliveries' link of the shipper top bar (GET /delivery/)
inputs_validation: none to type; read-only; shipper role only; any active shipper sees every READY order and the orders it holds (BR-25); customer contact is not shown here (BR-12)
displayed_result: Three groups: 'On my bike' (own picked-up orders, or 'Nothing picked up.'), 'Ready for pickup' (one card per order: number, ready-since time, hub -> address with distance, 'Cash on delivery' with the amount in bold, full-width 'Pick up this order') and 'My recent deliveries' (order, finished, result, cash); no row is written

control: Order page of a waiting delivery (GET /delivery/orders/<id>)
inputs_validation: order must have a delivery (404 'There is no delivery for this order. It may not be ready yet.'); an order held by another shipper is refused with 403 'Another shipper is delivering this order.'; the customer's name and phone are shown only to the shipper who holds the order (BR-12, BR-25); read-only
displayed_result: Order number, badge 'Awaiting pickup', hub, delivery address with distance, 'Collect <amount> in cash' (or 'Paid online: take no cash'), ready time, the dishes as '1 x name' and 'Pick up this order'; no customer contact yet

inputs_validation: delivery must be AWAITING_PICKUP and unassigned; the claim is atomic so only the first of two shippers wins (BR-25); the loser gets 'Order N has already been picked up. Nothing was changed.' and a 403 page 'Not allowed / Another shipper is delivering this order.' with 'Back to deliveries'
displayed_result: Winner: order page with 'You picked up order N.', badge 'Picked up', the customer's name and phone link, picked-up time, and the two forms 'Delivered' and 'Could not deliver'. Loser: the red message above an error page and a 44 px 'Back to deliveries' button; nothing is changed

control: 'Confirm delivery' button with the field 'Cash collected (VND)' (POST /delivery/orders/<id>/delivered)
inputs_validation: only the shipper who holds the order (BR-25); COD: the amount must be a whole VND number, not negative, and exactly equal to the order total ('Collect exactly N VND in cash and enter that amount.'); ONLINE: the field is not shown and no cash may be taken ('This order was paid online. Do not take cash from the customer.'); a second finish is refused (BR-17 and BR-25 keep the committed outcome)
displayed_result: Success: 'Order N is delivered.', badge 'Delivered', finished time and 'Cash collected' with the amount; the forms disappear. Wrong amount: the same page with the red message and no state change

control: 'Report failed delivery' button with the field 'What happened' (POST /delivery/orders/<id>/failed); browser confirmation 'Report that order N could not be delivered?'
inputs_validation: reason required and at most 200 characters ('Please say why the delivery failed.'); only the shipper who holds the order and only while it is picked up (BR-25); BR-17: COD voided, ONLINE refund pending for the full captured amount
displayed_result: 'The failed delivery of order N is recorded. Bring the food back to the hub.', badge 'Failed', finished time and a 'Problem' line with the reason; the forms disappear and only 'All deliveries' remains
